records.title: Intelligence Delivery Network: Toward an Internet Architecture for the AI Age
records.reason: It addresses AI inference service delivery, routing, and caching across deployment tiers, a direct systems/serving connection.

records.title: VLMaxxing through FrameMogging Training-Free Anti-Recomputation for Video Vision-Language Models
records.reason: The contribution is inference-time state reuse for a video VLM; it reduces recomputation and reports query latency improvement. The workload is specifically video multimodal inference.

records.title: ShrinKV: Key-Value Cache Compression with Progressive Hidden States Shrinking to Mitigate Prefilling Latency
records.reason: The candidate title indicates KV-cache compression for prefill latency, but registered DOI `https://doi.org/10.1109/icassp55912.2026.11463859` and IEEE Xplore `https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11463859` did not yield the publisher abstract (the document route displayed an inaccessible JavaScript/captcha page). A conference-program entry and author-hosted PDF were found, but neither is used as the registered publisher abstract. Primary evidence remains unavailable.

records.title: Depth Registers Unlock W4A4 on SwiGLU: A Reader/Generator Decomposition
records.reason: The primary abstract explicitly characterizes the work as a training-time probe rather than a deployment proposal; it is also withdrawn and no PDF is available.

records.title: SA-ANT: Efficient Low-Bit Group-Wise Quantization for Large Language Models via Sign-Asymmetric Adaptive Numeric Type
records.reason: This is an LLM inference quantization design with hardware area/power results and quality evaluation. The DOI/IEEE page was inaccessible, but the official DATE 2026 proceedings PDF is a primary conference source; its abstract and relevant performance results were reviewed. Body review: Official DATE 2026 proceedings identify low-bit group-wise LLM quantization and report area, power, and accuracy comparisons. The IEEE DOI page was unavailable; the conference proceedings PDF is the primary evidence.

records.title: Hive: A Multi-Agent Infrastructure for Algorithm- and Task-Level Scaling
records.reason: The abstract describes runtime caching and resource scheduling for model agents, a plausible inference-serving efficiency connection.

records.title: Trust-Aware Routing for Distributed Generative AI Inference at the Edge
records.reason: It is an inference routing policy for distributed edge generative AI and explicitly evaluates route-selection latency.

records.title: Accelerating Paypal's Commerce Agent with Speculative Decoding: An Empirical Study on EAGLE3 with Fine-Tuned Nemotron Models
records.reason: This is an empirical deployment study of speculative LLM decoding with direct throughput/latency results on a real agent workload.

records.title: WAND: Windowed Attention and Knowledge Distillation for Efficient Autoregressive Text-to-Speech Models
records.reason: The primary abstract targets standalone text-to-speech generation, an audio application outside this LLM inference/serving scope.

records.title: SR-TTT Does Not Learn Retrieval: A Correction and Mechanistic Post-Mortem of Surprisal-Aware Residual Test-Time Training
records.reason: The paper directly studies an inference-time memory substitute for long-context models and provides a correction about when that technique fails. Its negative result is relevant to inference-memory design; no successful retrieval improvement is claimed.
